location.provenance: THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF NEVADA, REPRESENTED IN SENATE AND ASSEMBLY, DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS:

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals that contain at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: a person, political subdivision, local government or state or local agency shall not discharge, use or release, or allow its employees or independent contractors to discharge, use or release, any Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

who.provenance: a person, political subdivision, local government or state or local agency shall not discharge, use or release, or allow its employees or independent contractors to discharge, use or release

action.provenance: shall not discharge, use or release, or allow its employees or independent contractors to discharge, use or release

value: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
products.provenance: any Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

value: Testing the Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances unless the person testing the foam has ensured that any measures necessary for the proper containment, treatment and disposal of the foam are available at the testing location and such measures will prevent the release of Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances to the surrounding environment
exceptions.provenance: for the purpose of:(a) Testing the Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances unless the person testing the foam has ensured that any measures necessary for the proper containment, treatment and disposal of the foam are available at the testing location and such measures will prevent the release of Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances to the surrounding environment; or (b) Firefighting training.

intentionally_added.provenance: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
